resource_risks.description: Repository clone launches a Git subprocess that could run too long or produce too much output.
resource_risks.mitigation: clone_desktop_workspace uses the existing bounded command runner with a 120 second timeout and 24 KB output cap, records capability_missing if Git is absent, and redacts credential-bearing repository URLs before state/report exposure.

resource_risks.description: Managed cloned workspaces can grow in app data and should remain scoped to an explicit managed root.
resource_risks.mitigation: Cloned repositories are placed under the app runtime data managed-workspaces root, and workspace folder names are validated and length-capped.

resource_risks.description: Workspace state persistence should not leave persistent handles or write outside the app data boundary.
resource_risks.mitigation: State reads and writes use bounded JSON files under runtime-data/workspace-host and create parent directories explicitly.

resource_risks.description: Selecting or cloning a workspace triggers source file refresh, which must remain bounded.
resource_risks.mitigation: The existing source catalog scan caps entries and returned results while skipping private, output, VCS, dependency, build, cache, and symlink entries.

resource_risks.description: Browser smoke used a temporary local static server.
resource_risks.mitigation: The static server was stopped after the Browser smoke and no long-running server remains for close-out.
evidence: Browser smoke server at http://localhost:4177 was stopped with Ctrl-C after validation.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: run_bounded_command terminates on process completion or timeout and returns a bounded report.
evidence: corepack pnpm --filter platform-desktop-app run runtime:contract: passed

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No persistent handle is kept after read/write; app-selected workspace can be replaced by a later import or clone.

measurement_checks.metric: Git clone timeout and stdout/stderr output bound
